feature_name: Streaming JSON Import for Memory Optimization
description: Implement streaming JSON parsing during document import to significantly reduce peak memory usage. Replace the current approach that loads the entire manifest file into memory with a streaming solution that processes records one at a time. This will eliminate the large memory allocation that currently accounts for the majority of memory usage during import operations.
functional_requirements: Replace the monolithic json.load() call with a streaming JSON parser that processes records sequentially
Maintain all existing validation and decryption logic while processing records in streaming fashion
Ensure backward compatibility with existing manifest file formats and import workflows
Add appropriate error handling for malformed JSON during streaming parsing
Update tests to verify memory usage improvements and functional correctness
Add the required streaming JSON library dependency to the project configuration
